title: 노을빛 해변 승강장
description: 바닷바람이 스치는 작은 승강장의 영화 같은 순간에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.

generation.promptA:
Create image A for a premium cooperative spot-the-difference game.
Landscape 3:2 composition, fixed camera, richly detailed but visually readable.
Theme: 노을빛 해변 열차 승강장. Scene: A quiet seaside local train platform at golden hour. A young adult traveler in a light jacket waits beside a small suitcase while an orange station cat sits nearby. Include a parked bicycle with a front basket, a simple round station clock without numbers, a closed parasol, a flower planter, a signal lamp, a bench, a small drink vending machine with blank color panels and no writing, overhead power lines, distant ocean waves, and an approaching original blue-and-cream local train. Every important prop is clearly separated and readable..
Art direction: original contemporary Japanese comics-inspired illustration, expressive clean ink linework, cinematic panel-like composition, selective full color with subtle screentone texture, polished game art, not imitating any specific artist or franchise.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Keep important objects away from the outer 3% safe margin.
generation.promptB:
Create image B by editing this image for a spot-the-difference puzzle with exactly 5 differences.
Preserve the camera, crop, characters, composition, lighting, palette, texture, and every unedited detail exactly.
Make exactly 5 localized, clearly visible object-level changes distributed across the scene.
Use changes such as one object color, a small accessory, count, direction, or missing object. Avoid global color or lighting changes.
Do not add text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Requested change guidance: Make only these five changes: 1) change the traveler's scarf from teal to red, 2) remove the bicycle's front basket, 3) reverse the orange cat's curled tail direction, 4) remove one yellow flower from the planter, 5) change the signal lamp from green to amber. Keep the traveler, face, hands, pose, suitcase, train, ocean, camera, crop, lighting, and every other object pixel-consistent.
